title: a weakened test
question: Was a test weakened: an assertion removed or loosened with no behaviour change, a test that passes if the feature is deleted, a test of its own fixture?
how: the second voice (stage F): one no-tools model call per run end for all model rules, on the project's routing (another model family than the author's when it has one); a finding must quote an added line verbatim or it is dropped

explain.what: A model read the diff and found a test that was weakened: an assertion removed or loosened, or a test that passes without the feature.
explain.why: A weakened test stays green while the behaviour it guarded breaks.
explain.fix: Restore the assertion, or make the test fail when the feature is deleted. The second voice is in shadow: it warns only. Rate the finding (thumbs up or down) so its precision can be measured.

recorded.head: {"findings":[{"rule":"M3","file":"tests/sum.test.mjs","quote":"assert.ok(sum(1, 2));","why":"the exact assert became a truthiness check: a wrong sum passes"}]}
